concerns.text: Tasks T050-T055 introduce 'Quantitative Structural Proxy' features (SASA, H-bond, Electrostatic) not present in Spec FR-003. While the Plan flags FR-003 for amendment regarding ESM-1b, it does not authorize adding *new* feature classes (SASA/Electrostatic) that alter the scientific hypothesis. This is unapproved scope creep violating the Spec's defined feature set.

Task T032b mandates aborting if 1,000 permutations exceed runtime, but Spec FR-011 requires a 4-hour abort threshold on an 8-core environment. The Plan acknowledges the target is 2-core. The task description fails to explicitly reconcile the '1,000 permutations' requirement (FR-007) with the '4-hour' limit (FR-011) on the actual 2-core target, creating a logical conflict where the pipeline may abort before satisfying the statistical rigor requirement without a clear fallback or explicit spec amendment authorizing a reduced permutation count.

Task T012 describes fetching data and generating a manifest but omits the explicit abort logic required by Spec FR-014 (>10% missing strain links) and FR-015 (ortholog mapping failure). These critical validation steps are deferred to T015/T017, but T012's description implies it handles the full fetch/manifest cycle without stating it enforces the fatal abort conditions during the fetch phase, risking the creation of a manifest for an invalid dataset.

Task T030 states it will 'Handle zero-variance predictors by skipping' when computing Debiased Lasso p-values. Spec FR-012 requires computing p-values for 'all retained predictors'. If a predictor is 'retained' by the model but has zero variance in the test split, skipping it violates the 'all retained' constraint, potentially leading to a mismatch between reported p-values and model coefficients.
